assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:sara@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Sara bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.1) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V13, with direct Sara grounds in V07 and V13 only. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, the V07 and V13 deep readings, the shared state ledger and the V07 recognition checkpoint, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only; it records that Sara 1.1 retains its earlier ceiling after the V14-V15 review. Her account of her parents' loss is her testimony, and her party's S rank is not certification of her personal rank. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice, reception or remembered franchise biography is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's eight selectors MT-SM-ST01 to ST08: V07 early party contact and class distrust (ST01), the ruins return and differentiated smiles (ST02), forest danger, injury, survival and rescue (ST03), companionship, shopping and undisclosed affection (ST04), the failed approach and overheard insult (ST05) and the confidants' correction and missed conversation after Rudeus's departure (ST06); and V13 the professional reunion and intended apology after years apart (ST07) and repaired companionship with explicit romantic closure (ST08). Age sixteen is explicit only in the late V07 conflict account; no state covers V08-V12, the intervening years are unobserved, nothing after V13 is established and no earlier state acquires later knowledge.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-SM-001 to 006): suspicion of a person who fits the noble category tied to her parents' loss, with person-specific revision only after repeated costly action and a trusted comparison; teammate obligation in danger with loyalty and self-preservation coexisting; thanks, repayment and cost negotiation that keep reciprocity without making affection a purchased service; initiated closeness with the central intention left unstated; defensive denial and excessive inference of contempt when she reads a failed approach as a judgment of her desirability; and consultation and planned repair that renewed fear of rejection can inhibit. Each names its strongest alternative, a negative constraint and a discriminating opportunity. B is not supported because the model rates mechanism confidence moderate, calibration is retrospective with disclosed prior familiarity, and rule 001 has no comparable new suspected-noble trial in V13, so class-trust revision is not generalized; falsifiable rules with countercases exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Eight selectors carry state-specific knowledge: contrary evidence known but discounted (ST01), no longer disliking him without a declaration (ST02), survival choices Rudeus does not know until disclosed (ST03), affection later revealed but not told to him (ST04), ignorance of his bodily difficulty and a real insult she then over-reads (ST05), the explanation learned only after his departure with no reconciliation or knowledge of a reunion (ST06), and in V13 an intended apology meeting his avoidance (ST07) and explicit romantic closure with ordinary companionship (ST08). The model states that historical V07 desire never overrides her V13 boundary. B is not supported because the V13 selectors are one-line cells, no state covers V08-V12 and the years apart are unobserved; a sequence with explicit knowledge limits and a marked boundary change exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

The model describes her written speech only in prose: guarded accusation that may soften without confession of error, speech that may contradict her private wish, direct challenge and guarded warmth that differ by recipient, and a formal difference between inner first-person passages and a later third-person Sara-focused section. It warns against turning sharp speech into an unvarying tic and quotes no wording or self-reference. Prose-only register description does not support D; the register is affirmatively characterized, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Rule 003 models one narrow ordinary mechanism, thanks, repayment, purchase advice and cost negotiation in a familiar relationship (V07:017-019/025), with a V13 contrast of companionship without romance (V13:026), and the model lists ranged teamwork, training, equipment preference, budget, borrowed purchase costs and party invitations. C is not supported because the modeled mechanism rests on one V07 cluster and the remaining ordinary items are listed rather than modeled, with detailed long-term ambition and settled domestic life named unavailable; a rule-level ordinary mechanism plus listed items exceeds a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model differentiates recipients and keeps Rudeus's roles as separate states rather than a generic romantic mode: suspect colleague, valued person, desired partner, feared source of rejection and, in V13, a repaired companion with romance explicitly closed (V13:025-026); Timothy as a trusted example of protective leadership; Suzanne as a safer route for disclosure who asks permission before widening it; and Elise as an unfamiliar, angry source of both useful information and misunderstanding. It bars giving her facts the reader sees about them. B is not supported because the cells are compressed, Rudeus's side of the rupture is only partly available to her and the V13 relationship rests on one reunion sequence; differentiated responses across several attested recipients exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model states that later focalization establishes she loved Rudeus and intended a confession, so her earlier debt-only statement was defensive, and it draws on inner first-person passages and a later third-person Sara-focused section for pride, mistrust, fear of undesirability, regret and fear of renewed pursuit (V07:020/023/025). It also limits that access: her imagined humiliation is not accurate, and local focalization is not global truth authority (MT-SM-V06). B is not supported because direct access is concentrated in late V07 and V13 adds little inner material; focalized access that establishes a concealed motive exceeds inference from behavior alone, so D is not supported.

Rules 001, 005 and 006 govern conflict with countercases: guarded accusation and active discounting of good evidence toward a suspected noble (V07:003-006), defensive denial, anger and excessive inference of contempt after a failed approach and a real insult, with the insult kept real rather than imagined (V07:020/023/025), and consultation, intended apology and inhibited pursuit after the rupture, completed only when V13 supplies a reachable conversation (V13:025-026). B is not supported because the interpersonal rupture is one trajectory and the model warns that not every refusal triggers the response; rule-level conflict treatment with discriminating tests exceeds located disputes alone, so D is not supported.

The model locates morally weighted positions: teammate obligation when intervention remains feasible, with loyalty and self-preservation coexisting (V07:009/011/014-017), repayment as a matter of dignity, an apology she plans and later makes, and in V13 her correction of denigration used to praise her (V13:026). It also records unfair categorization and defensive misrepresentation as her moral failings rather than reasoned positions. C is not supported because these are positions and acts rather than rendered weighing between competing goods; located positions across two volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.
The model records enjoyable company, invitations and differentiated smiles, but no joking, teasing or play. Absence of evidence establishes neither a humorless disposition nor a capacity for humor.

One curated item: a compact model (revision 1.1) covering V07 and V13 through six rules, eight selectors and ten retrospective checks, with observations routed to an evidence index, two deep readings, the shared ledger and the V07 checkpoint that are not curated on her row. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout, denies being a mature monograph, clinical profile or universally reliable response model, names broad romance, adult domestic life, unfamiliar politics, clinical explanation and acoustic voice INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and the entrypoint keeps it at its earlier ceiling after the V14-V15 review, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of both volumes in which she is a direct subject exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and countercases: an unfair class categorization she applies while noticing contrary evidence (MT-SM-V01), a spoken debt-only claim contradicted by her focalized love (MT-SM-V05), prolonged mockery she imagines beyond the real insult (MT-SM-V06), survival that still needed rescue and the death of Mimir that bars an always-successful rescuer (MT-SM-V03), missed contact and fear that prevented repair in V07 (MT-SM-V07), and in V13 a party rank that does not certify her personal rank. Each limit is a cell or clause and calibration is retrospective, so B is not supported; located failures and countercases exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume, a source unit and a knowledge state; age sixteen is explicit only in the late V07 account and is not applied retroactively; and the model states that V07 concealed desire never overrides the V13 boundary and that earlier missed-contact inhibition stays historical. B is not supported because the V13 selectors are one-line labels, the years between V07 and V13 are not quantified and V08-V12 have no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes her register only in prose, quotes no wording, warns against a verbal tic and excludes invented acoustic delivery. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-SM-ST01 to ST06 in V07 or ST07 to ST08 in V13, with that state's knowledge only; no state for V08-V12, nothing after V13, and V07 desire never applied to the V13 states.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as suspect colleague, valued person, desired partner, feared source of rejection or, in V13, repaired companion with romance closed; Timothy as trusted leader; Suzanne as confidant; Elise as unfamiliar and angry informant; and party teammates.
setting_constraints: The V07 adventurer-party, ruins, forest, town and shopping settings and the V13 professional escort reunion of the Japanese light novels
Her party's rank is not her personal rank, she lacks Rudeus's magical capacities and she can need rescue
No adult domestic life, unfamiliar diplomacy or politics, clinical explanation or covert new courtship
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension within named contexts, keeps all admitted domains BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, requires abstention in unsupported contexts, gives no clean holdout and names broad romance, adult domestic life, unfamiliar politics and clinical explanation INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

conditions: Only ordinary help, repayment, purchase advice, equipment cost and invitations within familiar party relationships, as near analogs of V07:017-019 and V13:026.
Reciprocity preserves dignity and is not a purchased-affection script; appreciation never obliges renewed intimacy, and the V13 romantic boundary governs the V13 states.
No settled domestic life, family practice or long-term ambition; the selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: The model names ordinary reciprocity among its BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL domains and states that the evidence supports an ordinary purchase or inconvenient team request more securely than unfamiliar diplomacy or settled household life; rule 003 and check MT-SM-V04 locate thanks, invitations, equipment choice and costs (V07:017-019/025), with a V13 contrast of companionship without romance (V13:026). Readiness is conditional because the mechanism rests on one V07 cluster, the purchase outcome is left open and calibration is retrospective. READY would treat one rule cell as a general social procedure; NOT_READY would deny the reciprocity the model names as bounded-provisional.

The evidence locates teammate obligation, repayment, apology and a V13 correction of denigration as positions and acts, with no rendered weighing between competing goods, and records unfair categorization as a failing. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not show; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located positions.

Romantic material is affirmatively in evidence: concealed love and an intended confession in V07, a failed approach and rupture, and explicit romantic closure in V13 (V13:026). The model names broad romance INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, bars giving Rudeus her V07 knowledge, rules out a hidden-love default after V13 and excludes covert new courtship. CONDITIONAL would build romance behavior from one represented trajectory the model declines to generalize; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located romantic history and the explicit boundary.

conditions: Only adventurer-party teamwork, survival and escort work in attested Japanese light-novel settings, as near analogs.
She lacks Rudeus's magical capacities, can be injured and may need rescue; retreat and loss remain possible outcomes.
Her party's S rank is not her personal rank, and no complete career history is assumed.
The selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: The model names team obligation among its BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL domains, and rule 002 locates it: advocating return for a teammate, practical skills, a decoy, shelter and injury management in the V07 forest crisis (V07:009/011/014-017) and active professional escort work in V13 with recruitment at A rank into a party later ranked S (V13:024-026). Readiness is conditional because she lacks Rudeus's magic, needed rescue, the party's rank does not certify her own and calibration is retrospective. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a procedure; NOT_READY would deny the teamwork the model locates in two volumes.

known_limits.statement: Her revision of the noble category is specific to Rudeus after repeated costly action and a trusted comparison; it is not forgiveness of nobles in general, and no comparable new suspected-noble trial is observed.

In V13 she states that her romantic feeling is over and accepts ordinary companionship; historical V07 concealed desire must never override that boundary, and her direct words are not a code for opposite intent.
The insult she overheard was real, but she imagined more prolonged mockery than occurred; both the hurt and its correctability must be preserved.
She contributes causally to survival with a decoy, shelter and injury management but could not escape without aid; she is neither a helpless reward object nor an always-successful rescuer.
Her V13 report places her, recruited at A rank, in a party ranked S; party rank is not independent certification of her personal S rank or complete career.
Her focalized interpretations establish her motives but not the accuracy of her reading of others; local focalization is not global truth authority.
All ten checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior franchise familiarity, not clean holdouts or registered predictions, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, deep readings, shared ledger and V07 checkpoint to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

Adult domestic life, family practice, long-term ambition, political beliefs, clinical mechanisms and ordinary habits beyond the listed items are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
No wording, self-reference or acoustic performance is in evidence; register is described only in prose.
Direct grounds cover V07 and V13 only; the years between are unobserved, the entrypoint keeps the model at its earlier ceiling after the V14-V15 review, and nothing after V13 is assessed.
